terms.name: Governability
terms.definition: A property of a consequential process describing the extent to which legitimate parties can understand, influence, constrain, correct, or recover its operation and outcomes. It does not imply complete predictability or a single controller.

terms.name: Outcome–purpose divergence
terms.definition: A condition in which meeting an immediate objective or metric degrades the benefit or purpose that justified pursuing it. The divergence can occur through narrow measures or indirect consequences without an intent to deceive.
